it: \bCi credi a un posto del genere?

id: \bI travel this desert everyday to visit the town.
en: \bI travel this desert everyday to visit the town.
it: \bAttraverso questo deserto ogni giorno per andare in città.

id: \bThere is a cave of ice ahead.
en: \bThere is a cave of ice ahead.
it: \bPiù avanti c'è una grotta di ghiaccio.

id: \bI just feel like diving into the ocean.
en: \bI just feel like diving into the ocean.

id: \bI can't believe a kid made it this far.
en: \bI can't believe a kid made it this far.
it: \bNon ci credo che un ragazzino sia arrivato fin qui.

id: \bBe careful. The ice can trip you up.
en: \bBe careful. The ice can trip you up.
it: \bFai attenzione. Il ghiaccio può farti scivolare.

id: \bI found a few fossils but I guess I don't need them all. Please take one.
en: \bI found a few fossils but I guess I don't need them all. Please take one.
it: \bHo trovato qualche fossile, ma credo di non averne bisogno di tutti. Prendine uno, per favore.

id: \bYou want another one? I suppose that's fine.
en: \bYou want another one? I suppose that's fine.
it: \bNe vuoi un altro? Va bene, suppongo.

id: \bI don't have a secret. I just wanted to sound cool.
en: \bI don't have a secret. I just wanted to sound cool.
it: \bNon ho nessun segreto. Volevo solo sembrare figo.

id: \rMy friend claims he saw a rare Pokémon.
en: \rMy friend claims he saw a rare Pokémon.
it: \rUn mio amico giura di aver visto un Pokémon raro.
\rDicono che qui vicino vivano dei Trapinch.
